_doc: Worn bag meshes, one per game/data/bags.json bag. Skinned to the survivor skeleton like the armour pieces: wear with RiggedModel.attach_skinned(skeleton, <dir>/<file>). Tint: multiply the material "bag_body" albedo by the bag's primary-material colour (spec 35); "bag_trim" (fibre straps) and "bag_bone" (toggles) keep their own colours. Built by tools/blender/bags/build_bags.py.
